skills.name: newlogic-online
skills.description: Edit, build, and deploy static websites hosted on Newlogic Online through its MCP server. Use whenever the user wants to change, create, preview, or publish a website managed by Newlogic Online — discover accessible sites, run an edit session, download and rebuild a project or edit files directly, deploy to Test, upload media, connect site forms, manage backups and rollback, or publish to Production.
headings: 3. Start the session and ask the kickoff questions — one message
5. Edit loop — static sites (works from plain chat)
7. Wrap-up — only when the requested batch is done
skills.description_zh: 通过 Newlogic Online MCP 编辑、构建和部署其托管静态网站，发现站点、运行编辑会话、下载重建、预览测试、上传媒体、连接表单、管理备份回滚及发布生产版本。
